text:
The sympathetic supply to the colon, the viscus involved in this irritable bowel picture, originates from preganglionic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column of the thoracolumbar cord, roughly T10 to L2, and reaches the prevertebral ganglia through the thoracic and lumbar splanchnic nerves. The team note saying L3–L5 is incorrect for this, since those segments do not give the colon's sympathetic supply. The note may be describing a different structure or a different question.

CONFIDENCE: 70
